The adjacent `json_resume_v1_schema.json` is the official JSON Resume schema pinned
at version 1.0.0, retrieved on 14 October 2026:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jsonresume/resume-schema/v1.0.0/schema.json

Upstream project: https://github.com/jsonresume/resume-schema (MIT license).
Used only as a portable export contract fixture; no schema is fetched at runtime.
